repos.name: google/artemis
repos.description: ARTEMIS turns natural-language instructions into reliable Android automation. It automates end-to-end workflows, captures logs for debugging and analysis, and integrates seamlessly with AI coding assistants such as Antigravity, Codex, and Claude Code. On the AndroidWorld benchmark, ARTEMIS achieves a success rate of over 99%.
repos.one_liner: An AI-driven framework for automating end-to-end Android workflows via natural language instructions.
bullets: Built on Python with deep integration for Android UI automation and log analysis.
Translates high-level natural language intent into precise, reliable device interactions.
Ideal for automated QA testing, regression suites, and complex mobile workflow orchestration.
Captures granular logs to facilitate debugging and performance analysis of mobile applications.

Features write-access to highlights and shelf management, streamlining knowledge capture.
Useful for power users and researchers looking to integrate reading workflows into broader AI-driven knowledge management systems.
